class Admin::OrderItemsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_portal_user!
  before_action :authorize_admin
  before_action :set_order
  before_action :set_order_item, only: [ :show, :edit, :update, :destroy ]

  # GET /orders/:order_id/order_items
  def index
    @order_items = @order.order_items.includes(:product)
  end

  # GET /orders/:order_id/order_items/:id
  def show
  end

  # GET /orders/:order_id/order_items/new
  def new
    @order_item = @order.order_items.build
  end

  # GET /orders/:order_id/order_items/:id/edit
  def edit
  end

  # POST /orders/:order_id/order_items
  def create
    @order_item = @order.order_items.build(order_item_params)

    if @order_item.save
      redirect_to portal_admin_order_order_item_path(@order, @order_item), notice: "Order item was successfully created."
    else
      render :new
    end
  end

  # PATCH/PUT /orders/:order_id/order_items/:id
  def update
    if @order_item.update(order_item_params)
      redirect_to portal_admin_order_order_item_path(@order, @order_item), notice: "Order item was successfully updated."
    else
      render :edit
    end
  end

  # DELETE /orders/:order_id/order_items/:id
  def destroy
    @order_item.destroy
    redirect_to portal_admin_order_order_items_path(@order), notice: "Order item was successfully removed."
  end

  private
    # Use callbacks to share common setup or constraints between actions.
    def set_order
      @order = Order.find(params[:order_id])
    end

    def set_order_item
      @order_item = @order.order_items.find(params[:id])
    end

    # Only allow a list of trusted parameters through.
    def order_item_params
      params.require(:order_item).permit(
        :product_id,
        :price,
        :discount_price,
        :tax,
        :tax_price,
        :description
      )
    end
end

module Sales
  class OrdersController < ApplicationController
    include ExceptionHandler
    include GaTrackable

    before_action :authenticate_portal_user!
    before_action :authorize_sales
    before_action :set_order, except: [ :create, :index ]

    def index
      @orders = current_portal_user.sales_orders
                     .exclude_customer_stage
                     .filter_and_sort(
                       query: params[:q],
                       status: params[:status],
                       sort_column: params[:sort],
                       sort_direction: params[:direction],
                       page: params[:page]
                     ).includes([ :sales, :location, :customer,
                               :akta_attachment, :npwp_attachment, :nib_attachment,
                               :ktp_owner_attachment, :ktp_pic_attachment,
                               :account_statement_attachment, :power_of_attorney_attachment,
                               :mou_attachment, { order_items: [ :product ] } ])
    end

    def create
      @submitted_data = {
        package_id: params[:package_id],
        total_msisdn: params[:total_msisdn],
        customer_type: params[:customer_type]
      }

      # > get product
      product = Product.find(@submitted_data[:package_id])

      # > create order model
      item_quantity = @submitted_data[:total_msisdn].to_i
      @order = Order.new
      @order.sales = current_portal_user
      @order.status = :draft
      @order.form_stage = :customer_stage
      @order.customer_data_approval = :pending

      @order.total_price = product.price * item_quantity
      @order.delivery_price = 0 # ! TODO: calculate delivery price
      @order.tax = product.tax
      @order.tax_price = product.tax == "exclude" ? (@order.total_price * 11 / 100) : 0
      @order.discount_price = 0 # ! TODO: calculate discount price
      @order.security_deposit = product.security_deposit # security deposit always use tax exclude (added 11% by system)

      # > create order item
      order_item = OrderItem.new(
        product: product,
        price: product.price,
        discount_price: 0,
        tax: product.tax,
        tax_price: product.tax == "exclude" ? (product.price * 11 / 100) : 0,
        description: product.description,
        item_quantity: item_quantity
      )
      @order.order_items << order_item

      @order.save!
      logger.info "Order Created: #{@order.inspect}"

      # Store tracking data in session for the next page (due to redirect)
      session[:track_order_creation] = true
      session[:customer_type] = @submitted_data[:customer_type]

      redirect_to customer_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order)
    end

    def sim_cards
      @order = current_portal_user.sales_orders
        .includes(order_items: { postpaid_activations: [ :msisdn, :iccid ] })
        .find_by(id: params[:id])

      unless @order
        redirect_to portal_sales_orders_path, alert: "Order tidak ditemukan."
        return
      end

      @sim_cards = []
      @order.order_items.each do |order_item|
        order_item.postpaid_activations.each do |activation|
          @sim_cards << {
            msisdn: activation.msisdn_number,
            iccid: activation.iccid_number,
            type: activation.parent? ? "parent" : "child"
          }
        end
      end
    end

    private
      def set_order
        @order = Order.find_by(id: params[:id])
        if @order.nil?
          redirect_to portal_sales_dashboard_path, alert: "Order not found"
        end
      end
  end
end

class Order < ApplicationRecord
  audited associated_with: :verified_by, only: [ :verified_by_id, :customer_data_approval ], comment_required: false

  # Audit verificator actions
  def self.audit_verificator_action(action_type, user, order, details = {})
    # Create a custom audit record with verificator context
    Audited::Audit.create!(
      auditable: order,
      user: user,
      action: "verificator_action",
      audited_changes: {},
      comment: {
        action_type: action_type,
        details: details,
        user_name: user.name,
        user_role: user.roles.first&.name
      }.to_json
    )
  end

  belongs_to :sales, class_name: "PortalUser", foreign_key: "sales_id"
  belongs_to :regular_user, class_name: "PortalUser", foreign_key: "regular_user_id", optional: true
  belongs_to :location, optional: true
  belongs_to :customer, optional: true
  belongs_to :verified_by, class_name: "PortalUser", optional: true

  before_create :build_order_reference_number

  # Active Storage attachment
  # lookup from document_approval.rb
  DocumentApproval::DOCUMENT_TYPES.each do |document_type|
    has_one_attached document_type.underscore.to_sym
  end
  has_one_attached :fab
  has_one_attached :delivery_proof

  # Add association with order items
  has_many :order_items, dependent: :destroy
  has_many :payments, dependent: :destroy
  has_many :postpaid_activations, through: :order_items

  # Document approvals
  has_many :document_approvals, dependent: :destroy


  # Get verificator audit timeline using Audited
  def verificator_audit_timeline
    audits.where(action: [ "update", "verificator_action" ])
          .includes(:user)  # Eager load user untuk avoid N+1 queries
          .order(created_at: :desc)  # Latest first (terbaru dulu)
          .limit(15)  # Limit to 15 latest records untuk performance
  end

  def audit_verificator_action!(action_type, user, details = {})
    Order.audit_verificator_action(action_type, user, self, details)

class OrderItem < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :order
  belongs_to :product
  has_many :postpaid_activations, dependent: :destroy

  accepts_nested_attributes_for :postpaid_activations, allow_destroy: true

  delegate :name, to: :product, prefix: true, allow_nil: true

  # Validations
  validates :price, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }
  validates :discount_price, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }
  validates :tax, presence: true
  validates :tax_price, presence: true, numericality: { greater_than_or_equal_to: 0 }
  validates :item_quantity, presence: true

  # Enum for tax (include/exclude)
  enum :tax, {
    exclude: 0,
    include: 1
  }

  # These methods require both MSISDN and ICCID as PostpaidActivations now require both
  def create_parent_postpaid_activation(msisdn, iccid)
    postpaid_activations.create!(
      msisdn: msisdn,
      iccid: iccid,
      status: :created,
      parent: true
    )
  end

  def create_child_postpaid_activation(msisdn, iccid)
    postpaid_activations.create!(
      msisdn: msisdn,
      iccid: iccid,
      status: :created,
      parent: false
    )
  end

  def create_child_postpaid_activations(msisdns, iccids)
    raise ArgumentError, "MSISDNs and ICCIDs arrays must have the same length" if msisdns.size != iccids.size

    msisdns.zip(iccids).map do |msisdn, iccid|
      create_child_postpaid_activation(msisdn, iccid)
    end
  end

  def postpaid_all_activated?
    postpaid_activations.present? && postpaid_activations.all? { |activation| activation.status == "activated" }
  end

  def parent_postpaid_activation
    postpaid_activations.find_by(parent: true)
  end

  def quantity
    item_quantity
  end

  def per_item_price_with_vat
    price + (tax == "exclude" ? tax_price : 0)
  end

  def total_price_with_vat
    (price + (tax == "exclude" ? tax_price : 0)) * item_quantity
  end
end

## Merge Request Review: ISB-2981 - Edit Product Order For Status Draft

### JIRA Requirement Summary

**Issue**: ISB-2981 - Edit Product order For Status order Draft (3)  
**Status**: In Review  
**Assignee**: Farhan Anshari  
**Sprint**: ISB Sprint 54

**Requirements**:
When an order status is "Draft", Sales should be able to edit product information through:
1. **Back button** from ICCID and MSISDN page → Edit button (blue) on the form page to edit all fields
2. **Edit pencil button** beside product name → Pop-up to choose product name and number of MSISDNs needed → Update button → Price updates on form page and MSISDN/ICCID page

---

### Implementation Review

#### ✅ **Alignment with JIRA Requirements**

The implementation **fully addresses** the JIRA requirements:

**Requirement 1**: Edit button functionality
- ✅ Implemented via `edit_customer` action (app/controllers/sales/orders_controller.rb:141-178)
- ✅ Opens in pop-up window using `form_window` layout
- ✅ Allows editing of all customer fields

**Requirement 2**: Edit pencil button for product
- ✅ Implemented via `edit_package` action (app/controllers/sales/orders_controller.rb:75-77)
- ✅ Pop-up interface for product selection and MSISDN quantity
- ✅ `update` action (app/controllers/sales/orders_controller.rb:80-116) handles price recalculation
- ✅ Updates propagate to both order and order_item levels

---

### Code Quality Analysis

#### ✅ **Strengths**

1. **Clean Architecture**
   - Separates concerns with dedicated actions: `edit_package`, `edit_customer`, `update`, `update_customer`
   - Uses pop-up window pattern via Stimulus controller instead of problematic modals
   - Reusable `form_window` layout for consistent UI

2. **Data Integrity**
   - Uses `ActiveRecord::Base.transaction` for atomic updates (lines 82-105)
   - Proper price recalculation logic matching original order creation
   - Tax calculation follows existing patterns: `product.tax == "exclude" ? (product.price * 11 / 100) : 0`

3. **Security Considerations**
   - Proper authentication (`before_action :authenticate_portal_user!`)
   - Authorization check (`before_action :authorize_sales`)
   - Strong parameters via `order_params` and `customer_params` methods

4. **Test Coverage**
   - Comprehensive RSpec tests in `spec/requests/sales/orders_spec.rb`
   - Feature specs for UI validation in `spec/views/sales/edit_order_popups_spec.rb`
   - Tests cover success and failure scenarios

5. **User Experience**
   - Conditional button visibility (only shows for draft orders)
   - Email notification when customer email changes
   - Window.opener.reload() pattern provides immediate feedback

---

#### ⚠️ **Concerns & Recommendations**

1. **Security: CSRF Token Skipping**
   ```ruby
   skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token, only: [ :update ]
   ```
   **Issue**: Line 10 disables CSRF protection for the `update` action  
   **Risk**: Medium - Opens potential CSRF vulnerability  
   **Recommendation**: 
   - Re-enable CSRF and fix the form to include `authenticity_token`
   - Use `data-turbo="false"` on the form instead of disabling protection
   - If Turbo is causing issues, ensure form has: `<%= hidden_field_tag :authenticity_token, form_authenticity_token %>`

2. **Error Handling**
   ```ruby
   raise "Order item not found for this order." unless order_item
   ```
   **Issue**: Line 87 uses generic `raise` instead of specific exception  
   **Recommendation**: Use `ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound` or custom exception class

3. **Hardcoded VAT Rate**
   ```ruby
   tax_price: product.tax == "exclude" ? (product.price * 11 / 100) : 0
   ```
   **Issue**: 11% VAT is hardcoded in multiple places (lines 96, 103)  
   **Recommendation**: Extract to constant `TAX_RATE = 0.11` in Order model

4. **Missing Validation**
   - No validation that order is in `draft` status before allowing updates
   - No check that `total_msisdn` is positive integer
   
   **Recommendation**: Add before_action check:
   ```ruby
   before_action :ensure_draft_status, only: [:edit_package, :update, :edit_customer, :update_customer]
   
   def ensure_draft_status
     unless @order.draft?
       flash[:alert] = "Only draft orders can be edited"
       redirect_to portal_sales_order_path(@order)
     end
   end
   ```

5. **Postpaid Activations Not Handled**
   - When product/quantity changes, existing `postpaid_activations` are not cleaned up
   - Could lead to orphaned MSISDN/ICCID reservations
   
   **Recommendation**: Add cleanup in `update` action:
   ```ruby
   # Before updating order_item
   if order_item.postpaid_activations.any?
     @order.release_reserved_msisdns_and_iccids!
   end
   ```

6. **HTML in Controller Response**
   ```ruby
   render html: "<script>window.opener.location.reload(); window.close();</script>".html_safe
   ```
   **Issue**: Inline JavaScript in controller violates separation of concerns  
   **Recommendation**: Create a dedicated view template or use Turbo Streams

7. **Missing I18n for Flash Messages**
   ```ruby
   flash[:notice] = "Package was successfully updated."
   ```
   **Issue**: Hardcoded English messages  
   **Recommendation**: Use I18n keys from config/locales/sales/

---

### Technical Architecture Review

#### Routes (config/routes.rb:6e5abdb3)
```ruby
member do
  get :sim_cards, to: 'orders#sim_cards'
  get :edit_package
  get :edit_customer
  patch :update_customer
end
```
✅ RESTful design  
⚠️ Consider renaming `update` to `update_package` for clarity (currently relies on implicit routing)

#### JavaScript/Stimulus Controllers
- ✅ `popup_window_controller.js` - Clean window.open() implementation
- ✅ `nik_edit_controller.js` - Conditional "Check NIK" button
- ✅ `form_submit_controller.js` - Form data handling

---

### Test Coverage Assessment

#### Request Specs (spec/requests/sales/orders_spec.rb)
✅ Tests both GET actions (edit_package, edit_customer)  
✅ Tests PATCH update with valid parameters  
✅ Tests error handling with invalid parameters  
✅ Tests authorization and authentication

#### Feature Specs (spec/views/sales/edit_order_popups_spec.rb)
✅ Tests form pre-population  
✅ Tests conditional button visibility based on order status  
⚠️ Missing: E2E test of actual form submission (due to Selenium constraints)

**Recommendation**: Add integration test for complete update flow:
```ruby
it "updates package and verifies price calculation" do
  visit edit_package_portal_sales_order_path(order)
  select new_product.name, from: 'package_id'
  fill_in 'total_msisdn', with: 15
  click_button 'Update'
  
  order.reload
  expect(order.order_items.first.product).to eq(new_product)
  expect(order.total_price).to eq(new_product.price * 15)
end
```

---

### Database Impact

**Schema Changes**: None (uses existing tables)

**Data Migration Concerns**:
- No backwards compatibility issues
- Existing draft orders can be edited immediately
- No data loss risk due to transaction wrapping

---

### Performance Considerations

✅ No N+1 query issues  
✅ Transaction usage prevents partial updates

module Sales
  class OrdersController < ApplicationController
    include ExceptionHandler
    include GaTrackable

    before_action :authenticate_portal_user!
    before_action :authorize_sales
    before_action :set_order, except: [ :create, :index ]

    def index
      @orders = current_portal_user.sales_orders
                     .exclude_customer_stage
                     .filter_and_sort(
                       query: params[:q],
                       status: params[:status],
                       sort_column: params[:sort],
                       sort_direction: params[:direction],
                       page: params[:page]
                     ).includes([ :sales, :location, :customer,
                               :akta_attachment, :npwp_attachment, :nib_attachment,
                               :ktp_owner_attachment, :ktp_pic_attachment,
                               :account_statement_attachment, :power_of_attorney_attachment,
                               :mou_attachment, { order_items: [ :product ] } ])
    end

    def create
      @submitted_data = {
        package_id: params[:package_id],
        total_msisdn: params[:total_msisdn],
        customer_type: params[:customer_type]
      }

      # > get product
      product = Product.find(@submitted_data[:package_id])

      # > create order model
      item_quantity = @submitted_data[:total_msisdn].to_i
      @order = Order.new
      @order.sales = current_portal_user
      @order.status = :draft
      @order.form_stage = :customer_stage
      @order.customer_data_approval = :pending

      @order.total_price = product.price * item_quantity
      @order.delivery_price = 0 # ! TODO: calculate delivery price
      @order.tax = product.tax
      @order.tax_price = product.tax == "exclude" ? (@order.total_price * 11 / 100) : 0
      @order.discount_price = 0 # ! TODO: calculate discount price
      @order.security_deposit = product.security_deposit # security deposit always use tax exclude (added 11% by system)

      # > create order item
      order_item = OrderItem.new(
        product: product,
        price: product.price,
        discount_price: 0,
        tax: product.tax,
        tax_price: product.tax == "exclude" ? (product.price * 11 / 100) : 0,
        description: product.description,
        item_quantity: item_quantity
      )
      @order.order_items << order_item

      @order.save!
      logger.info "Order Created: #{@order.inspect}"

      # Store tracking data in session for the next page (due to redirect)
      session[:track_order_creation] = true
      session[:customer_type] = @submitted_data[:customer_type]

      redirect_to customer_stage_portal_sales_order_path(@order)
    end

    def sim_cards
      @order = current_portal_user.sales_orders
        .includes(order_items: { postpaid_activations: [ :msisdn, :iccid ] })
        .find_by(id: params[:id])

      unless @order
        redirect_to portal_sales_orders_path, alert: "Order tidak ditemukan."
        return
      end

      @sim_cards = []
      @order.order_items.each do |order_item|
        order_item.postpaid_activations.each do |activation|
          @sim_cards << {
            msisdn: activation.msisdn_number,
            iccid: activation.iccid_number,
            type: activation.parent? ? "parent" : "child"
          }
        end
      end
    end

    private
      def set_order
        @order = Order.find_by(id: params[:id])
        if @order.nil?
          redirect_to portal_sales_dashboard_path, alert: "Order not found"
        end
      end
  end
end

```ruby
def ensure_draft_status

  end
```

```ruby
  ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
    order_item = @order.order_items.first
    product = Product.find(order_params[:package_id])
    item_quantity = order_params[:total_msisdn].to_i

    raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound, "Order item not found for this order." unless order_item

    # Clean up existing postpaid activations if quantity or product changed
    if order_item.postpaid_activations.any? && 
       (order_item.product_id != product.id || order_item.item_quantity != item_quantity)
      @order.release_reserved_msisdns_and_iccids!
    end

    # ... rest of update logic
  end
end
```
